era: Isle of Man TT motorcycle simulation
summary: Jester Interactive's Isle of Man TT road-racing trilogy for PlayStation 2, including the Suzuki-branded North American versions and PSN access routes for the first two games.

entries.title: TT Superbikes Real Road Racing

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 or original PlayStation 2 hardware; PSN route requires an owned legacy PS3 purchase.

primary.why: TT Superbikes Real Road Racing was developed exclusively for PlayStation 2 and focuses on the full Isle of Man TT course, unlike Sega's earlier Manx TT game. The PS3 North American PlayStation Store release is an access route to the same PS2 game, so PlayStation 2 via original hardware or PCSX2 is the main route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation 2 version on original hardware or PCSX2 with internal-resolution upscaling; the North American PS3 PSN version is an alternate access route if already owned.

entries.remaster_caveats: North America uses Suzuki branding; PS3 PSN availability was North America-only and only playable on PS3.

entries.title: TT Superbikes Real Road Racing Championship

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 or original PlayStation 2 hardware.

primary.why: Real Road Racing Championship is sourced as the first sequel to TT Superbikes, released on PlayStation 2 in Europe and later in North America with Suzuki branding. Its PS3 PlayStation Store release is an access route, not a remaster.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation 2 version on original hardware or PCSX2; use the North American PS3 PSN route only if already owned.

entries.remaster_caveats: North American version again used Suzuki branding; PS3 PSN route was North America-only and playable only on PS3.

entries.title: TT Superbikes Legends

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 or original PlayStation 2 hardware.

primary.why: TT Superbikes Legends is sourced as the third and final game in Jester's TT Superbikes series, released only for PlayStation 2 in Europe. With no other region or platform documented, the European PS2 release is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the European PlayStation 2 version on original hardware or PCSX2 with internal-resolution upscaling.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced North American, Japanese, PSN, or remastered release.
